subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Hui-Fang Zhu is a Canadian poet known for her contemporary verse.
• Zhu's poetry collection Fragments of Light was published in 2019.
• The collection won a Governor General's Literary Award in 2020.
• The Governor General's Literary Awards are given annually to the best Canadian books in various categories.
prompt: The student wants to indicate the title of a poetry collection that won a Governor General's Literary Award. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Hui-Fang Zhu published a poetry collection in 2019.
choices.B: Fragments of Light, by Hui-Fang Zhu, won a Governor General's Literary Award in 2020.
choices.C: Hui-Fang Zhu is an award-winning Canadian poet known for her contemporary verse.
choices.D: One of Hui-Fang Zhu's poetry collections was among the best Canadian books published in recent years.

explanation:
Choice B is the best answer. The sentence indicates the title of a poetry collection that won a Governor General's Literary Award, noting that Fragments of Light by Hui-Fang Zhu won the award in 2020.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect because the sentence provides an introduction of Hui-Fang Zhu; it doesn't indicate the title of a poetry collection that has won a Governor General's Literary Award.
